evidence: Changes C and C++ kernel API error reporting interfaces in `src/kernel/error.h`, `bitcoinkernel.h`, and `notifications_interface.h`.
rationale: Removes application-level translation machinery from libbitcoinkernel to advance kernel decoupling. The PR description notes this implements the kernel tracking issue #27587 objective to 'Remove translation.h usage from the kernel' by introducing typed C++ error structures and numeric error codes across the kernel boundary.
